## Research

Our research focuses on uncertainty quantification in computational science and engineering, specifically high-dimensional probabilistic modeling and inference for physical systems.

## Team

- [Ali Siahkoohi](https://alisiahkoohi.github.io/), Assistant Professor, *CS department*
- [Banafsheh Adami](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=qcURpaYAAAAJ), PhD student, *CS department*, co-advised with [Alain Kassab](https://mae.ucf.edu/person/alain-kassab/) (Fall 2026–present)
- [Anirudh Thatipelli](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=siY4W9gAAAAJ), PhD student, *CS department* (Summer 2025–present)

## Former members

- [Davide Sabeddu](https://davide-sabeddu.github.io/Portfolio/), PhD student, *ECE department* (Fall 2025–Summer 2026)
